use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

let n = 17

let residues =
    (1..n) |> map(i => i * i % n) |> collect_list()

linked(a: int, b: int) -> bool =>
    let d = ((a - b) % n + n) % n in
    residues |> any(r => r == d)

for a in 0..n do
    let row = (0..n) |> map(b =>
        if a == b then "-" elif linked(a, b) then "1" else "0" fi)

    write_line(row |> join(" "))
od

quads() -> Pipe[(int, int, int, int)] is
    for a in 0..n do
        for b in a + 1..n do
            for c in b + 1..n do
                for d in c + 1..n do
                    yield (a, b, c, d)
                od
            od
        od
    od
si

uniform(q: (int, int, int, int)) -> bool =>
    let (a, b, c, d) = q in
    let pairs = [(a, b), (a, c), (a, d), (b, c), (b, d), (c, d)] in
    let links = pairs |> filter(((x, y)) => linked(x, y)) |> count() in
    links == 0 \/ links == 6

let bad = quads() |> filter(uniform) |> count()

write_line()
write_line(
    "{quads() |> count()} sets of 4 nodes checked, "
    "{bad} totally connected or totally unconnected")

let image = IMAGE(420, 420)

image.view(-1.15D, -1.15D, 1.15D, 1.15D)
image.clear(252ub, 252ub, 250ub)

at(i: int) -> (x: double, y: double) =>
    let turn = cast double(i) / cast double(n) in
    let angle = Math.pi / 2.0D - 2.0D * Math.pi * turn in
    (x = Math.cos(angle), y = Math.sin(angle))

image.colour(40ub, 90ub, 180ub)
image.stroke(1.2D)

for a in 0..n do
    for b in a + 1..n do
        if linked(a, b) then
            let p = at(a)
            let q = at(b)

            image.line(p.x, p.y, q.x, q.y)
        fi
    od
od

for i in 0..n do
    let p = at(i)

    image.colour(200ub, 60ub, 40ub)
    image.dot(p.x, p.y, 11.0D)
    image.colour(255ub, 255ub, 255ub)
    image.text(p.x, p.y - 0.03D, 11.0D, "{i}", Raster.Anchor.CENTRE)
od

image.write("paley.png")

image.show("paley.png")
